prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
Interactive flows (new_flow) generated the largest wins (up to +14.8%), but predictions were often overly optimistic as multiple variants caused severe drops (down to -11.8%) or rollbacks.
Step reordering (reorder) drove strong wins (up to +12.0%), though predictions overshot as several variants caused severe drops (down to -8.9%) or no clear effect was seen.
UI redesigns (redesign) caused the largest performance drops (down to -19.3%), though recent layout redesigns yielded strong wins (up to +8.5%) that outperformed pessimistic predictions.
Wait-state information (wait_info) produced several solid wins (up to +6.1%), though no clear effect was seen for many variants.
Targeted copy updates (copy) achieved selective wins (up to +6.7%), particularly around account retrieval and persistence, though no clear effect was seen for most variants.
Hints, notifications, layout changes, and standalone screens produced no wins, with hints occasionally worsening performance (down to -3.1%) and no clear effect seen for the rest.

Changes:
0: [home, redesign] Stage Layout Redesign for Generation Waiting Screen: Redesigns the waiting screen into a dynamic stage layout with real-time status updates while companion assets load. (why: The waiting stage has a median duration of 201s (mean 2336s) and an 86.9% conversion rate, with support reporting setup stalling issues.)
1: [sign_in, copy] Sign-In Multi-Account Sync Assurance Copy: Updates the sign-in screen headline and body text to clearly explain that logging in protects and recovers saved pets across sessions. (why: The top support theme (8 emails) involves pets missing or reset after signing back in.)
2: [home, wait_info] Generation Time Remaining & Asset Extraction Breakdown: Displays live extraction step progress and estimated countdown time while pet graphics are generated. (why: Mean wait time on the waiting screen is high (2336s) and users report feeling stuck or experiencing app stalls.)
3: [choose_path, hint] Path Selection Estimated Duration Hint: Adds an explanatory hint to the choose_path screen clarifying that onboarding takes under 3 minutes. (why: The initial path selection step has the lowest step conversion rate (78.3%), indicating user hesitation at entry.)
4: [home, notification] Desktop Readiness Background Completion Notification: Enables a background desktop notification prompt on the waiting screen so users get alerted when pet generation completes. (why: Long background wait times (mean 2336s) lead users to close or abandon the app while waiting.)
5: [choose_path, layout] Story Welcome Stage Layout Overhaul: Switches the story intro layout to a structured stage format with progress indicators. (why: The initial step `choose_path` / `story` suffers from a low 78.3% conversion and a 514s mean time.)
